title: test: manually test instantsearch.js documentation, examples, lib on supported browsers
body:
Desktop: IE11 > Chrome
Mobile: iPhone Android recent ones

comments.body:
I'm adding notes here while testing:

## Fairphone (Android 4.2.2, Chrome 44)
- The "widget display" in the documentation do not get displayed
- Selecting a element in the menu select dropdown does not scroll to the correct part of the page
- None of the examples are working

JS must be broken somewhere. I'll be doing remote debugging on my Fairphone, but I first need to install the latest Chromium version...
Ok, that was simply the issue with loading scripts from various ports :)

Tested on IE11, working fine except for the small issues fixed in #628.

Still some issues in the e-commerce example to fix:
![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/11210255/18bd13e4-8d27-11e5-97f8-772e66bf406b.png)
Ok on IE12 and IE11. Now testing the iPad...
I'm considering this one closed until we have more devices to test
